name: Universe Has No Favorites
source:
One morning, Yax wakes up in an orbital station prison with his memory wiped. He doesn't know how he got there, he doesn't know why he's locked up in a prison, and he doesn't know what the implants in his head are for. So there's only one thing to do: break out of prison... and try not to die in the harsh environment of a space colony. Which will be quite a challenge, because danger lurks at every turn on the orbital station SAGA: its districts are teeming with street gangs, feral robots, backstabbing thugs, sneaky hackers, insane neurosurgeons, decadently depraved millionaires, cyber-courtesans and cannibalistic chefs. And even if Yax manages to successfully navigate his way through this labyrinth of technological crime, he's far from finished: he must discover just what dark mystery he's at the center of - and why does this secret threaten to destroy all of humanity.

A modern text-based illustrated adventure game with point & click controls. Just click on the interactive link in the text and you can explore the environment, use and collect items and store them in your inventory. Dialogues are also an important part of the game, thanks to which you will learn important (and unimportant) information that you will need to complete the game.

Enter a cyberpunk world written by legendary Czech sci-fi authors: Jiří W. Procházka, the father of Czech cyberpunk, author of the Ken Wood novels, and Štěpán Kopřiva, author of the epic Asphalt, a novel where a squad of mercenaries turn Hell upside down.
translation:
一天早上，亚克斯在轨道站监狱中醒来，他的记忆被抹去了。他不知道自己是怎么到那里的，他不知道自己为什么被关在监狱里，他也不知道头上的植入物是做什么用的。所以只有一件事要做：越狱……并尽量不要死在太空殖民地的恶劣环境中。这将是一个相当大的挑战，因为佐贺轨道站的每一个角落都潜藏着危险：它的地区充斥着街头帮派、凶猛的机器人、背后捅刀子的暴徒、狡猾的黑客、疯狂的神经外科医生、颓废堕落的百万富翁、网络妓女和食人的厨师。即使亚克斯成功地穿过这个技术犯罪的迷宫，他也还远远没有完成：他必须发现自己处于什么黑暗的谜团的中心，以及为什么这个秘密会威胁到毁灭全人类。

一款现代的基于文本的插图冒险游戏，带有点击控制。只需点击文本中的交互式链接，你就可以探索环境、使用和收集物品并将它们存储在你的库存中。对话也是游戏的重要组成部分，通过对话你将学到完成游戏所需的重要（和不重要）信息。

进入捷克传奇科幻作家笔下的赛博朋克世界：捷克赛博朋克之父、肯·伍德小说的作者吉里·W·普罗查兹卡 (Jiří W. Procházka) 和史诗巨著《沥青》的作者什捷潘·科普日瓦 (Štěpán Kopřiva)，这部小说讲述了一群雇佣兵颠覆地狱的故事。
